attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Create one high-resolution portrait-card fusion using exactly two inputs. Image1 original small card is the sole authority for clothing, pose, hair, expression, light, and crop. Image2 provides mascot identity and anatomy only. Transform the human anatomy into a smooth golden-yellow compact near-round mascot head and body, featuring green-ringed black eyes and a source-matching mouth. Preserve the real source hair: bareheaded, short grey/brown combed-back receding hair, and real grey eyebrow hair. Retain the actual short grey upper-lip moustache, clean smooth chin, and serious closed mouth. Maintain the dark olive/khaki open-lapel military coat, real pale khaki shirt collar, subdued dark khaki/grey necktie area, and source-exposed small gold lapel marks. Ensure a clearly rounded short U-shaped lower yellow head that immediately meets the raised and broadened existing neckline, with a very short broad neck transition and minimal throat exposure. Avoid any separate yellow neck shaft, pointed V funnel, pinched collar, neck rolls, floating collar, clipping, or cream belly bib. Preserve the actual open garment and fastening with coherent front/rear collar overlap and contact shadow. Retain the complete tilted dark frame, opaque photographic backing in its actual primary blue/grey color, and the attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. All solid surfaces must be opaque, with alpha only outside the complete card silhouette. Do not invent insignia, text, or accessories. Keep fine primary details understated and indistinct where they are in the source. No cap, spectacles, chin beard, closed high collar, or hidden chest regalia.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: BAREHEADED short GREY/BROWN combed-back receding hair, real grey eyebrow HAIR, actual short GREY upper-lip MOUSTACHE, clean smooth chin and serious CLOSED mouth. DARK OLIVE/KHAKI OPEN-lapel military coat, real PALE KHAKI shirt collar and subdued DARK KHAKI/GREY necktie area, source-exposed small GOLD lapel marks only. Preserve exact primary near-frontal mild angle/roll, BLUE/GREY photographic backing/light and note-limited crop. No cap, spectacles, chin beard, closed high collar or invented hidden chest regalia; tiny lettering/insignia unspecified.
Retain exact primary head angle, expression, cap shape, real hair and visible clothing/decoration areas. One compact near-round yellow mascot head with a clearly ROUNDED short chin immediately contacting raised broad collar, no V-shaped lower-face funnel or yellow shaft. Preserve actual dark solid cloth and photographic backing opacity. Tiny ambiguous features remain understated; no new badge engraving or decorations hidden behind note. Image1 exact original card; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
attempts.rejection_reason: Actually viewed unchanged primary and compatible larger analysis context, raw output, pair and white/cyan/alpha. Correct bare grey-brown combed hair/brows, actual short grey upper-lip moustache/clean chin, closed serious mouth, OPEN khaki coat/pale khaki shirt/dark tie, limited gold lapel marks and blue-grey backing. Reject pointed triangular yellow chin/throat funnel at narrow shirt opening; require compact rounded short chin and raised broad collar preserving actual moustache, pose and open military outfit. Complete frame/note/dark cloth opaque, no visible cyan holes.
